hunks.baseline: Seriously? I hadn’t even dated anyone since high school, and I had to be called a sex fiend?
hunks.sol: Seriously? I hadn’t even dated anyone since high school, and now I had to be called a sex fiend?

hunks.baseline: I spent half my day on raids and collapsed asleep in my goshiwon every night. Now I had to clean up a mess I hadn’t even made in a game.
hunks.sol: I spent half my day running raids and the other half passed out in my goshiwon. Now I had to clean up a mess I hadn’t even made, inside a game.

hunks.baseline: *This is insane. The Level gap is more than twice mine…*
hunks.sol: *This is insane. His Level is more than twice mine…*

hunks.baseline: This was a fight I couldn’t possibly take.
hunks.sol: This was a fight I absolutely couldn’t take.

hunks.baseline: I declined the Quest. Or I was going to. But Lee Seogeun beat me to it.
hunks.sol: I declined the Quest. Or tried to. But Lee Seogeun beat me to it.

hunks.baseline: “If you run away from this place… the Jin Family of Taiyuan will pay the appropriate price.”
hunks.sol: “If you run away now… the Jin Family of Taiyuan will pay the appropriate price.”

hunks.baseline: I had wondered why the System was giving me a choice for once.
hunks.sol: I’d wondered why the System was giving me a choice for once.

hunks.baseline: As I let out a deep sigh, the assembly hall was boiling like a cauldron over charcoal.
hunks.sol: As I let out a deep sigh, the assembly hall began boiling like a cauldron over hot coals.

hunks.baseline: “That young punk thinks he can say anything because he has his family’s backing!”
hunks.sol: “That young punk thinks he can say whatever he wants just because he has his family behind him!”

hunks.baseline: As the atmosphere turned hostile, Jin Wikyung, the Lesser Family Head, stepped forward.
hunks.sol: As the atmosphere turned hostile, Jin Wikyung, the Lesser Family Head, stepped in.

hunks.baseline: “Everyone, calm yourselves. And you, Young Hero, enough. Let us consider this a verbal slip and let it go this once.”
hunks.sol: “Everyone, calm yourselves. And you, Young Hero, that is enough. We will consider it a slip of the tongue and let it pass this once.”

hunks.baseline: Seated in the place of honor, he issued the warning in a low voice. His presence was no joke. He really did have the bearing of the next Family Head of a prestigious house with deep roots.
hunks.sol: Seated in the place of honor, he delivered the warning in a low voice. His presence was no joke. He truly had the bearing of the next Family Head of an old and prestigious house.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps cowed by that aura, Lee Seogeun answered in a noticeably quieter voice.
hunks.sol: Perhaps cowed by his aura, Lee Seogeun answered in a noticeably quieter voice.

hunks.baseline: “It was not a verbal slip. Do you think I came here as a private individual?”
hunks.sol: “It was not a slip of the tongue. Do you think I came here today merely as a private individual?”

hunks.baseline: At those words, Jin Wikyung’s expression hardened, and so did everyone else’s.
hunks.sol: At those words, Jin Wikyung’s expression hardened, along with everyone else’s.

hunks.baseline: Right. Lee Seogeun was an envoy officially sent by the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
hunks.sol: Right. Lee Seogeun was an official envoy of the Mount Heng Sword Sect.

hunks.baseline: “My father—no, the Sect Leader—has entrusted me with all authority.”
hunks.sol: “My father—no, the Sect Leader—has entrusted me with full authority.”

hunks.baseline: “……Then what is it you want?”
hunks.sol: “……Then what do you want?”

hunks.baseline: “As I already said, I want a duel with the Third Young Master.”
hunks.sol: “As I have already said, I want a duel with the Third Young Master.”

hunks.baseline: Judging by how things were unfolding, those bastards from the Mount Heng Sword Sect had come here looking for a fight.
hunks.sol: Judging by how things were unfolding, those bastards from the Mount Heng Sword Sect had come here specifically to pick a fight.

hunks.baseline: They intended to get as much as possible out of this incident, and even if that failed, they were going to wreck me, at least. Being targeted so blatantly sent a chill down my spine.
hunks.sol: They intended to squeeze everything they could out of this incident, and even if that failed, they were at least going to wreck me. Being targeted so blatantly sent a chill down my spine.

hunks.baseline: “Withdraw from every commandery and county except Taiyuan. That should be an appropriate price for ruining my sister’s chances of marriage.”
hunks.sol: “Withdraw from every commandery and county outside Taiyuan. That should be an appropriate price for ruining my sister’s prospects of marriage.”

hunks.baseline: From the bits and pieces I could make out, he was basically saying they intended to strip us of everything but our underwear. Jin Wikyung’s answer was obvious.
hunks.sol: From the bits and pieces I could make out, he was basically demanding they strip us of everything but our underwear. Jin Wikyung’s answer was obvious.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung was a complete pushover when it came to his youngest brother. There was no way he would push me into a duel that was obviously dangerous.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung was a complete pushover when it came to his youngest brother. There was no way he would send me into a duel that was obviously dangerous.

hunks.baseline: I wasn’t the only one who thought of that word. The assembly hall fell silent beneath the weight of it.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t the only one who thought of that word. The assembly hall fell silent beneath its weight.

hunks.baseline: I read the System message, looked at the floor, looked at the ceiling, and then read it again.
hunks.sol: I read the System message, looked at the floor, looked at the ceiling, then read it again.

hunks.baseline: Everyone reacted the same way this time. Wide eyes. Open mouths. Lee Seogeun, who had proposed the duel. Jin Wikyung, who had refused it. Every person in the assembly hall looked as if they doubted their own ears.
hunks.sol: For once, everyone reacted the same way. Eyes wide. Mouths open. Lee Seogeun, who had proposed the duel. Jin Wikyung, who had refused it. Everyone in the assembly hall looked as though they couldn’t believe their ears.

hunks.baseline: I left Jin Wikyung’s frantic attempt to stop me behind me and spoke to Lee Seogeun.
hunks.sol: Ignoring Jin Wikyung’s frantic attempt to stop me, I spoke to Lee Seogeun.

hunks.baseline: “Come out. Let’s have a go.”
hunks.sol: “Come on. Let’s have a go.”

hunks.baseline: The corners of Lee Seogeun’s mouth rose cruelly.
hunks.sol: The corners of Lee Seogeun’s mouth curled into a cruel smile.

hunks.baseline: The winter wind was cold. I took a deep breath while looking up at the cloudy sky.
hunks.sol: The winter wind was cold. I looked up at the cloudy sky and took a deep breath.

hunks.baseline: I faced Lee Seogeun on the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s Grand Training Ground. About fifty people sat some distance away, watching us.
hunks.sol: Lee Seogeun and I stood facing each other in the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s Grand Training Ground. About fifty people sat some distance away, watching us.

hunks.baseline: The Jin Family people wore expressions that seemed to ask what the hell I had eaten, while the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s goons looked like they had come out for a day of entertainment. The only thing missing was popcorn.
hunks.sol: The Jin Family people looked like they were wondering what the hell I had eaten, while the Mount Heng Sword Sect’s goons looked like they’d come out for a day of entertainment. All they were missing was popcorn.

hunks.sol: Ah. Someone was sending me a Sound Transmission, too.

hunks.sol: - Youngest. Take deep breaths. Deep breaths. In. Out. In. Out…

hunks.baseline: *I’m doing it, man.*
hunks.sol: *I’m already doing that, man.*

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung had a solemn expression, but he kept shifting his hips like a puppy that needed to poop. If Wipeng hadn’t been holding him down by the shoulder, he looked ready to charge into the training ground at any moment.

hunks.baseline: He had radiated such overwhelming force in the assembly hall, yet Jin Wikyung was once again living up to my expectations.
hunks.sol: He had radiated such overwhelming authority in the assembly hall, yet Jin Wikyung was once again living up to my expectations.

hunks.baseline: With Jin Wikyung and Wipeng, I had two life insurance policies. Excellent.
hunks.sol: With Jin Wikyung and Wipeng, I had two life insurance policies. Great.

hunks.baseline: But the moment I looked at Lee Seogeun with that slightly lighter feeling, I withdrew my thoughts.
hunks.sol: But the moment I looked at Lee Seogeun with a slightly lighter heart, I immediately took that thought back.

hunks.baseline: *What’s so excellent about this? Fuck.*
hunks.sol: *What’s so great about this? Fuck.*

hunks.baseline: Lee Seogeun suddenly stripped off his upper garments, and my breath caught at the muscles writhing like some kind of mollusk.
hunks.sol: Lee Seogeun abruptly whipped off his shirt, and my breath caught at the sight of muscles writhing like mollusks.

hunks.baseline: The sixteen-Level gap was overwhelming. As if to drive that fact home, the System rang.
hunks.sol: A gap of sixteen Levels. It was overwhelming. As if to drive that fact home, the System chimed.

hunks.baseline: “Do you understand the situation now? Your breath is caught, and your hands and feet are tingling, aren’t they?”
hunks.sol: “Do you understand the situation now? Your breath catches, and your hands and feet start tingling, don’t they?”

hunks.baseline: He could read minds now, too?
hunks.sol: Now he could read minds, too?

hunks.baseline: I deliberately composed my expression before answering.
hunks.sol: I forced my expression under control before answering.

hunks.baseline: “Your voice is trembling. Of course you’re afraid. Fine. If you answer my questions honestly, I’ll go easy on you.”
hunks.sol: “Your voice is trembling. Of course you’re afraid. Fine. Answer my questions honestly, and I’ll go easy on you.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh? Putting on the airs of a martial family’s son, are you?”
hunks.sol: “Oh? So you’re still the son of a martial family, is that it?”

hunks.baseline: Lee Seogeun laughed as if I were ridiculous.
hunks.sol: Lee Seogeun laughed scornfully.

hunks.baseline: “Let me ask you one thing. What made you accept the duel? You, whose martial arts are pathetic and who is infamous for being a coward. I want to hear the reason.”
hunks.sol: “Let me ask you one thing. What made you accept the duel? Your martial arts are pathetic, and you’re notorious for being a coward. I want to hear your reason.”

hunks.baseline: “The reason?”
hunks.sol: “My reason?”

hunks.baseline: Hunting? Leveling up? I could forget about it. The moment I left the fence of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, assassins who caught my scent would come running.
hunks.sol: Hunting? Leveling up? I could forget about it. The moment I stepped outside the protection of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, assassins would catch my scent and come running.

hunks.baseline: *As long as I stay alive, there will be another chance.*
hunks.sol: *As long as I stay alive, there’ll be another chance.*

hunks.baseline: “I thought someone like you might be manageable.”
hunks.sol: “I figured I could handle someone like you.”

hunks.baseline: “Pfft! You’re just a wet-behind-the-ears pup.”
hunks.sol: “Pfft! You ignorant little pup.”

hunks.baseline: “Is it my turn to ask questions now?”
hunks.sol: “Is it my turn to ask a question?”

hunks.baseline: “I never said I’d answer them… but I’ll indulge you as if they were your last words.”
hunks.sol: “I never said I would answer… but I’ll indulge you as if these were your last words.”

hunks.baseline: “This incident. You fabricated it, didn’t you?”
hunks.sol: “This whole incident. You fabricated it, didn’t you?”

hunks.baseline: Perhaps the question was unexpected, because Lee Seogeun’s expression stiffened awkwardly.
hunks.sol: Perhaps the question caught him off guard, because Lee Seogeun’s face stiffened awkwardly.

hunks.baseline: *There it is.*
hunks.sol: *So I was right.*

hunks.baseline: I had wondered if that was the case, but sure enough. No wonder the whole thing had smelled rotten from beginning to end.
hunks.sol: I’d suspected as much. No wonder the whole thing had stunk from beginning to end.

hunks.baseline: “You petty bastards. You should have just declared war.”
hunks.sol: “You petty bastards. You should’ve just declared war.”

hunks.baseline: Lee Seogeun lifted a massive greatsword and muttered ominously.
hunks.sol: Lee Seogeun raised his massive greatsword and muttered ominously.

hunks.baseline: I raised the Sharp Spear I had drawn earlier.
hunks.sol: I leveled the Sharp Spear I had taken out earlier.

hunks.baseline: I had learned martial arts. I also had instincts honed by seven years of real combat.
hunks.sol: I had learned martial arts. I also had instincts honed through seven years of real combat.

hunks.baseline: An F-rank Hunter and a second-rate Murim martial artist. Don’t underestimate the skills I had honed working two jobs!
hunks.sol: An F-rank Hunter and a second-rate Murim martial artist. Don’t underestimate the skills I’d honed working two jobs!

hunks.baseline: Lee Seogeun was more agile than I had imagined. He closed the distance in an instant, and I blocked the greatsword crashing down vertically with the shaft of my spear.
hunks.sol: Lee Seogeun was more agile than I had imagined. He closed the distance in an instant, and I caught the greatsword crashing straight down with the shaft of my spear.

hunks.baseline: I had wondered if I would be split in two, but the Sharp Spear was sturdy as a solid piece of steel. However, the force behind the greatsword began driving both my feet into the ground.
hunks.sol: I’d been afraid it might cut me in half, but the Sharp Spear was sturdy, made of solid steel. Even so, the force behind the greatsword began driving both my feet into the ground.

hunks.baseline: “Kneel and beg for forgiveness now! Then I’ll let you off with one arm!”
hunks.sol: “Kneel and beg forgiveness now! Then I’ll let you off with just one arm!”

hunks.baseline: - Little brother!
hunks.sol: - Youngest!

hunks.baseline: Over Lee Seogeun’s shoulder, I saw Jin Wikyung spring to his feet. The Mount Heng Sword Sect’s people watched while snickering, and the Jin Family people turned their heads away as if they couldn’t bear to watch.
hunks.sol: Over Lee Seogeun’s shoulder, I saw Jin Wikyung shoot to his feet. The Mount Heng Sword Sect’s people watched with snickers, while the Jin Family people turned their heads away as if they couldn’t bear to look.

hunks.baseline: At least until Jin Wikyung got here!
hunks.sol: At least until Jin Wikyung gets here!

hunks.sol: Lee Seogeun’s greatsword came at me from every direction, one blow after another. The weapons were clearly clashing, iron against iron, but all I could hear was cannon fire.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, Lee Seogeun and I met each other’s eyes.
hunks.sol: The next moment, Lee Seogeun and I locked eyes.

hunks.baseline: The moment I saw the bewilderment and confusion in his gaze, I knew he was thinking exactly what I was.
hunks.sol: The instant I saw the bewilderment and confusion in his gaze, I knew he was thinking exactly what I was.

hunks.baseline: Lee Seogeun was strong. He possessed the brute strength of a giant monster, moved with surprising agility for someone with that much muscle, and swung his massive greatsword like a matchstick.
hunks.sol: Lee Seogeun was strong. He possessed the brute strength of a giant monster, moved with surprising agility for someone so muscular, and swung his massive greatsword like a matchstick.

hunks.baseline: And that wasn’t all. He was a Young Master of the Mount Heng Sword Sect—a sect that could actually throw its weight around. The martial arts he used had to be quite advanced.
hunks.sol: And that wasn’t all. He was a disciple of the Mount Heng Sword Sect, a sect powerful enough to throw its weight around. The martial arts he used had to be fairly advanced.

hunks.sol: Even now, I was blocking every swing of his greatsword. More than twenty attacks, and more than twenty blocks.

hunks.baseline: I slowly lifted one of my legs, which had been buried in the ground up to the ankle. It came free with ease.

hunks.baseline: *Could this be…*

hunks.baseline: At that moment, I redirected the greatsword flying toward my waist along the shaft of my spear. Then, without thinking, I kicked Lee Seogeun in his unguarded chest.
hunks.sol: At that moment, a greatsword swept toward my waist. I deflected it with the shaft of my spear, then reflexively kicked Lee Seogeun in his wide-open chest.

hunks.sol: Clutching his stomach, Lee Seogeun skidded back five or six steps. Then he casually rubbed the bridge of his nose as though nothing had happened.

hunks.baseline: “You’re not bad. You’ve got a trick or two, despite being trash.”

hunks.sol: A beat later, a thin line of blood ran from the corner of Lee Seogeun’s mouth. He must have bitten his tongue. That had to hurt.
